During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''space landing platform''' in the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]]. It was guarded by two [[Patrol ship/Legends|system patrol craft]], and served as a staging area for military convoys deploying to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
